description: FAKE vectors for the reading-aid pair contract (docs/architecture/mycarlos-delivery.md, Reading aids). Regenerate with: python -m tests.reading_aid_pair_reference

keys.derivation: as tests/fixtures/delivery-contract.json: every key is FAKE, from its seed text

clinic_a.seed_text: FAKE delivery contract test key: clinic-a signing key 1

clinic_a_revoked.seed_text: FAKE delivery contract test key: clinic-a signing key 0 (revoked)

unknown_clinic.seed_text: FAKE delivery contract test key: an unknown signing key

device.x25519_seed_text: FAKE delivery contract test key: device 1 x25519
device.ed25519_seed_text: FAKE delivery contract test key: device 1 ed25519

other_device.x25519_seed_text: FAKE delivery contract test key: device 2 x25519
other_device.ed25519_seed_text: FAKE delivery contract test key: device 2 ed25519

sender.note: CARLOS builds the aid JSON (JCS canonical), signs the manifest (JCS plus RFC 6979), seals with a fresh ephemeral key, and stages the original and the aid together

notice.heading: AI-generated reading aid — open the original document
notice.body: FAKE notice body: this reading aid was produced by software and checked by a clinician. It is not your medical record. Open the original document for what your clinic recorded.

reading_aid.overview: FAKE chest X-ray report: the report describes the chest images and a plan.

points.text: FAKE: no acute change is described compared with the earlier images.
evidence: FAKE no acute change compared with the prior study.

points.text: FAKE: a repeat image is planned in three months.

accept.name: a reading aid for a filed original
past expiry, within the 24 h device clock skew
an aid the device filed but never confirmed
accept.note: the receipt was lost after filing; send it again and file nothing

accept.name: an aid kept waiting, seen again in a later listing
accept.note: the two copies travel on their own, so the aid may be listed first: kept by delivery ID and ciphertext hash, checked again after each original is filed until it expires; the same listing hash is not downloaded again

a es reading aid with its own notice version

refuse.note: an older build that only knows mycarlos-delivery/1 refuses it and files nothing

refuse.name: tampered ciphertext
a reading aid listed larger than its limit
refuse.note: refused from the listing's outer record, before any download

refuse.name: plaintext labelled as a future reading-aid version
two plaintext parts
a manifest of the original's type
a claim missing
an extra claim
the aid names itself as its own original
a reading aid that is not JSON media
a reading aid larger than the limit
signed by an unknown clinic key
signed by a revoked clinic key
sealed for another device

refuse.name: signed IDs differ from the outer record
the sealed aid is not the one the manifest signs
the aid JSON is not canonical
the aid's language is not the manifest's
an empty evidence list
expired, beyond the clock skew
a different copy under a filed aid's delivery ID
a different copy under a waiting aid's delivery ID
an aid under a filed original's delivery ID
refuse.note: one delivery-ID space across originals and aids

refuse.name: a reviewer role outside the closed set
a notice version whose language tag is not the aid's language
an aid whose lifetime is not its original's
refuse.note: created_at and expires_at must equal the filed original's; no receipt is sent

refuse.name: an aid bound to another PDF than the filed original
